plan.summary: BRO-6493: independently sourced opening and preview corrections, same-day confirmations, and Silver Manhattan venue correction (part 1 of 3)
steps: BRO-6493: 2026 SoHo production page explicitly gives February 7 for first preview and opening. Producer announcement distinguishes February 15 and 16 press performances from February 7 run start, resolving the conflicting listing. Sources: https://playbill.com/production/hold-on-to-your-butts-off-broadway-soho-playhouse-2026 https://www.broadwayworld.com/off-broadway/article/Recent-Cutbacks-To-Bring-HOLD-ON-TO-YOUR-BUTTS-To-Soho-Playhouse-In-2026-20251118

No separate preview period; TodayTix corroborates the March 7 to 29 engagement.
